info.title: Saranga console API
info.description: Every path but /session, /views, /nodes, /events, /history, /notifications, /address-settings, /security-settings and /openapi.json is served for another node too, at /saranga/api/v1/nodes/{node}/... (a node ID from GET /nodes; local is this broker): it is sent to that node as management messages, as the user, and that node allows or refuses it. At /saranga/api/v1/nodes/all/... the listings span every node.
